claim: Prospective commit-citation gate on the todo front door: mix cb.todo.close requires every new close to either cite its implementing commit (--commit <full-40-hex-sha>, validated by CB.CommitLocator and resolved against the repository, recorded as a commit key on the todo record) or explicitly record that no commit implements the discharge (--no-commit, marked uncommitted: true, with the reason carried in the notes). Silent omission stops being possible at the door; historical done records are untouched. mix cb.verify.commits extends to dereference every recorded todo commit, so the done->commit rung of the b545 loop is CI-enforced going forward without failing the pre-gate history.

evidence.detail: Implemented and discharged same-day through the gate itself: t0023 closed with --commit citing the implementing sha, recorded as the first commit key in the todo collection. All three verify.commits directions pass.

todos.action: Gate mix cb.todo.close on explicit commit citation (--commit validated+recorded, or --no-commit marked uncommitted) and extend mix cb.verify.commits to dereference recorded todo commits
todos.notes: b563: the done->commit rung, enforced prospectively at the front door so history is untouched.
